packageRules.description: netboxcommunity/netbox publishes bare NetBox tags (v4.6.8), compound NetBox + netbox-docker tags (v4.6.8-5.0.2) and prereleases (v4.7.0-beta1-5.0.2) side by side. This role pins a compound tag, so restrict candidates to that shape: `loose` versioning orders the compound tags correctly but happily ranks a bare v4.5.1 above a compound v4.4.9-4.0.1, which is how this pin has been derailed before.
